faq: No. We make the buying path clearer and remove friction, and we give you the numbers to judge it. Results depend on your products, prices and traffic.
Will you change my prices or products?
No. We work on pages, wording, layout, and checkout steps. Pricing decisions stay with you, though we may point out where a price looks out of place.
Do I need much traffic for an A/B test?
A few hundred visits per variant is a sensible minimum. With less traffic we skip the test on Premium and spend that time on further proven fixes.
Are discount pop-ups and urgency timers included?
Only honest ones. We do not add fake countdowns or false stock claims, since those break consumer rules and platform policies. Real offers with real end dates are fine.
